description: This Java source file defines the IncomingRequestPhoneService class, which extends WearableListenerService. It handles incoming messages from wearable devices, processes permission requests and data retrieval, and communicates responses back through the GoogleApiClient.

classes.name: IncomingRequestPhoneService
classes.description: A service handling incoming data and permission requests from a wearable device, responding appropriately with status or data.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, parses request type, and delegates to specific handlers.

methods.name: promptUserForStoragePermission
methods.description: Checks for storage permission, prompts user if not granted.

methods.name: respondWithStorageInformation
methods.description: Responds with directory listing if permission is granted, or requests permission if not.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message back to the connected wearable device using GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: isExternalStorageReadable
methods.description: Checks whether external storage is available for reading.
